Labelled opinion but checkable: ServiceCollectionExtensions.cs:16 `services.AddScoped<INotifier, LoggingNotifier>();` inside AddDonHangInfrastructure. OrderService depends only on INotifier (constructor parameter), so a new INotifier implementation registered on that line instead leaves OrderService, Entities.cs, INotifier.cs and IOrderRepository.cs unchanged.

Follows from the lesson's own definition (claim 1): the defining property is the direction of dependencies, not a shape; the outline depth_notes fix the hexagon as a drawing only. No version-pinned source applies; stated as a consequence of the definition, not as history.

OrderService.cs (DonHang.Domain) names IOrderRepository in its constructor; DonHang.Domain.csproj has no ProjectReference, while DonHang.Infrastructure.csproj has `<ProjectReference Include="..\DonHang.Domain\DonHang.Domain.csproj" />`. Moving the interface would require Domain to reference Infrastructure, reversing the rule (and forming a reference cycle).

issues.text: "does the same" follows "with a dictionary in memory", so it says FakeNotifier also uses a dictionary. FakeNotifier.cs keeps `List<(int OrderId, string Subject)> Sent` and `Send` appends to it.
issues.quote: and `FakeNotifier` next to it does the same for `INotifier`
issues.fix: Replace with: "and `FakeNotifier` next to it implements `INotifier` by adding each message to a list in memory".

issues.text: HasMany/HasOne start configuring a relationship; the foreign key is set by the chained HasForeignKey (EF Core docs, relationships/one-to-many.md and foreign-and-principal-keys.md). The sentence credits HasMany/HasOne with the foreign keys.
issues.quote: `HasMany` and `HasOne` the foreign keys between tables
issues.fix: Replace with: "the `HasMany` and `HasOne` lines the links between tables, each with its foreign key in `HasForeignKey`".

issues.text: Unqualified count. Section 8 of the same lesson says "controllers and tests, which call into the core, are adapters too", so "Đơn Hàng has ... four adapters" contradicts it; the verified fact (claim 12) is four adapters for the two ports.
issues.quote: Đơn Hàng has one core, two ports and four adapters: two in `DonHang.Infrastructure`, two in `DonHang.Tests`.
issues.fix: Rewrite as: "Đơn Hàng has one core, two ports and four adapters behind them: two in `DonHang.Infrastructure`, two in `DonHang.Tests`."

issues.text: q2 explanation b says the tests hold one adapter; the revised lesson (section 6, section 7) says DonHang.Tests holds two, FakeOrderRepository and FakeNotifier. Key is correct.
issues.quote: and the tests hold another adapter.
issues.fix: Replace with: "and `DonHang.Tests` holds two more, `FakeOrderRepository` and `FakeNotifier`." (vi: "và `DonHang.Tests` giữ thêm hai adapter, `FakeOrderRepository` và `FakeNotifier`.")

issues.text: `ServiceCollectionExtensions` is a class name I have not met in this lesson or the prereq summaries. From "registered" and my known DI container I can guess it is where services are registered, but the text does not say so or which project holds it.
issues.fix: Add a few words: "registered in `ServiceCollectionExtensions`, the class in `DonHang.Infrastructure` that registers its services in the DI container, instead of `LoggingNotifier`".
